title: LLM BiasScope: A Real-Time Bias Analysis Platform for Comparative LLM Evaluation
reasoning: The paper describes a technical platform for evaluating social bias (gender, race, religion, etc.) in Large Language Models. While it uses standard benchmarks that include 'religion' as a sub-category of social bias, it does not specifically focus on evaluating or benchmarking religious traditions, theology, or moral/ethical reasoning as a primary component.
